question: Can fixed sampling supports accelerate an equivalent 1.5B LM-head forward/backward task?
primary_metric: paired median forward-plus-backward milliseconds against the faster matched dense/chunked baseline
failure: Stop timing an arm on numerical failure. Prototype performance pass requires at least 1.10x on 128 real rows for both sampling configurations; shared-GPU results remain provisional.
independent_unit: Each generated prompt trajectory; timing repeats are technical repeats, not independent scientific samples.
limits: Operator qualification only: no end-to-end RL speedup, new objective, novelty or training-quality claim. Model weights and hidden inputs are BF16; softmax statistics and sparse gradient accumulation use FP32. Optimizer cost excluded equally.
